title: Narra 4.1.16
message: My List, TV access, audio fallback, and release updates are more reliable in this release.
changelog: Comic details now merge native and hosted issue feeds instead of caching a single empty response.
Comic issue search remains visible, readable issues open in Narra, and official-source issues are clearly identified.
Saved comics and comic reading progress now appear in their own Library section.
Anime caption files use the working subtitle proxy path, restoring selectable captions when providers return them.
Anime recommendations combine AniList, Tenrai, and hosted results while isolating individual source failures.
Episode downloads show preparation and transfer progress immediately and block duplicate download requests.
Library now has one removable My List across saved books, audiobooks, anime, manga, comics, and drama.
TV Profile and TV playback use the same verified Premium state, with ads bypassed only when entitled.
TV checks the official update manifest at startup; free viewers cannot dismiss an update, while Premium can dismiss optional releases.
Anime playback can move to another provider and, when needed, the other audio pool without mislabeling the active mode.
Provider requests include Origin and remember a successful audio mode to improve CDN playback recovery.
Narra package, Profile, integrity check, release manifest, and APK are synchronized at build 22.
